number_of_biological_replicates: About 150 intact mouse islets per condition (N = 5) were collected and washed x3 in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
number_of_fractions: Fractions were collected every 1 min and combined into 13 final fractions based on the UV chromatogram and subsequently dried by vacuum centrifugation.
number_of_samples: A total of 100 µg tryptic peptides from each sample were labeled with TMT10 plex according to the manufacture’s protocol (Controls: TMT126-TMT128C; BMP-2: TMT129N-TMT131).
technology_type: All LC-MSMS raw data files were searched using Proteome Discoverer version 2.1.
